app.Farblegende unter dem Energiefluss, inkl: Color legend below the energy flow, including the blended tone for the share from own generation.
app.Verbraucher mit zugewiesener Gruppe (sie: Consumers with an assigned group (see below) then appear as one combined row instead of individually — devices without a group remain listed individually.

app.Zähler „aus dem Netz bezogene Energie\": Counter “energy drawn from the grid” (kWh, increasing).
app.Zähler „ins Netz eingespeiste Energie\": Counter “energy fed into the grid” (kWh, increasing).
app.Beliebig viele Erzeuger, z. B. Dach-PV u: Any number of generators, e.g. rooftop PV and an additional balcony power plant.
app.Zähler „von diesem Erzeuger produzierte: Counter “energy produced by this generator” (kWh, increasing).
app.Beliebig viele Batteriespeicher, z. B. e: Any number of battery storage units, e.g. a home battery and a separate balcony power plant with its own storage. Values across several storage units are summed (energy) or capacity-weighted averaged (state of charge).
app.Zähler „aus dem Speicher entnommene Ener: Counter “energy taken from the storage” (kWh, increasing).
app.Zähler „in den Speicher geladene Energie: Counter “energy charged into the storage” (kWh, increasing).
app.Nutzbare Gesamtkapazität, nur nötig für: Usable total capacity, only needed for the kWh display. An entity takes precedence; Wh is converted automatically.
app.Beliebig viele einzeln erfasste Verbrauc: Any number of individually recorded consumers, e.g. wallbox or heat pump. Via a group (e.g. “Mobility”) several of them can be combined into one node in the energy flow.
app.Zähler „von diesem Verbraucher verbrauch: Counter “energy consumed by this consumer” (kWh, increasing).
app.Optional — fasst mehrere Verbraucher im: Optional — combines several consumers in the energy flow into one node.
app.Der Rest (Netzbezug + Erzeuger − Verbrau: The remainder (grid import + generators − consumers − feed-in − storage charging) appears automatically as “base load” — no separate sensor needed.
app.Optional — Preis-Sensoren für Netzbezug: Optional — price sensors for grid import and feed-in. Calculated per bucket, so it also works with variable/dynamic tariffs. Without a suitable price entity, a fixed price in cents per kWh can be entered instead — if an entity is chosen, it takes precedence.
app.Preis in Cent/kWh, wird mit dem bezogene: Price in cents/kWh, multiplied by the imported electricity to give the grid import costs.
app.Vergütung in Cent/kWh, wird mit der eing: Remuneration in cents/kWh, multiplied by the fed-in energy to give the feed-in revenue.
app.Nur für Anlagen mit einer echten Zahlung: Only for systems with an actual payment on self-consumed electricity (e.g. CHP bonus) — for most systems this field stays empty. Remuneration in cents/kWh, multiplied by self-consumption (generation minus feed-in) and added to the feed-in revenue in the balance.
app.Optional — Prognose-Sensoren, z. B. von: Optional — forecast sensors, e.g. from Forecast.Solar or Solcast.
kWh still expected today (e.g. Forecast.Solar “Estimated energy production – remaining day”).
app.kWh, die für morgen insgesamt erwartet w: kWh expected in total for tomorrow.
app.Optional — CO2-Intensität des bezogenen: Optional — CO2 intensity of the imported grid electricity (g/kWh), e.g. via an Electricity Maps / CO2 Signal entity. PV and storage count as emission-free and need no factor of their own. Without a suitable entity, a fixed value can be entered instead — if an entity is chosen, it takes precedence.
app.g CO2/kWh &mdash; ergibt mit dem Netzbez: g CO2/kWh — gives the emissions when multiplied by grid import and the avoided CO2 when multiplied by PV self-consumption.
app.Fasst mehrere Verbraucher im Energieflus: Combines several consumers in the energy flow into one lane, e.g. “Mobility”.
app.Noch nicht eingerichtet. Ordnet Netzbezu: Not set up yet. Assign grid import, generators, storage and consumers to an entity each — the Sankey flow is then created automatically.
app.Energiebilanz-Prüfung, Datenqualitäts-Ch: Energy balance check, data quality checks and unusually high consumption for the selected period.
app.Kein Verbraucher/keine Gruppe deutlich ü: No consumer/group significantly above the usual average.
app.CO2-Ausstoß durch Netzbezug und vermiede: CO2 emissions from grid import and CO2 avoided through PV self-consumption, for the selected period.
app.Vermiedenes CO2 = PV-Eigenverbrauch × CO: Avoided CO2 = PV self-consumption × CO2 factor of grid import, i.e. the CO2 the grid import would otherwise have caused. Balance = emissions − avoided.
app.Netzbezug-Kosten, Einspeisung-Erlös und: Grid import costs, feed-in revenue and balance for the selected period.
app.Einsparung = PV-Eigenverbrauch × Netzbez: Savings = PV self-consumption × grid import price, purely calculated, not included in the balance. Balance = grid import costs − feed-in revenue.
app.Entladung ÷ Ladung je Monat (letzte drei: Discharge ÷ charge per month (last three years) — shows whether the storage efficiency changes over time (e.g. due to battery aging).
app.Noch nicht genug Historie für einen Tren: Not enough history for a trend yet — needs at least one full month with charge/discharge activity.
app.Anteil des Verbrauchs, der NICHT aus dem: Share of consumption that did NOT come from the grid, per month (last three years).
app.Noch nicht genug Historie für einen Tren: Not enough history for a trend yet.
app.Anteil der Erzeugung, der selbst verbrau: Share of generation that was self-consumed (not fed in), per month (last three years).
app.Ø Ladezustand je Monat (letzte drei Jahr: Avg. state of charge per month (last three years).
app.Gesamtverbrauch im gewählten Zeitraum: e: Total consumption in the selected period: recorded consumers together with the base load (devices not measured individually, calculated from the balance).
app.Netzenergiebilanz = Netzbezug − Einspeis: Net grid energy balance = grid import − feed-in. Positive: more imported than fed in (net import). Negative: more fed in than imported (net feed-in).

app.„Zeit“ formatiert die Einschaltdauer je: “Time” formats the on-duration per bar readably (e.g. 1h 29m) — useful for presence, door and motion sensors. “ON/OFF” shows the raw value.

app.Der Index ist die SQLite-Datei <code>ind: The index is the SQLite file index.sqlite. It contains metadata, configuration and operating histories, but not the actual measurement series: raw values are in the hot buffer and archive, aggregates in the rollups.
app.SQLite nutzt freie Seiten von selbst wie: SQLite reuses free pages on its own. The file is only rewritten compactly when an optimization is started.
app.Index jetzt optimieren? Die Indexdatei w: Optimize the index now? The index file is rewritten compactly; writes are paused briefly in the meantime.
app.Die Werte beruhen auf belegten SQLite-Se: The values are based on occupied SQLite pages; indexes are attributed to their table. {index_overhead_size} are attributable to internal structures and free pages.
app.Die Dateigröße enthält auch interne Stru: The file size also includes internal structures and free pages. This SQLite runtime does not provide sizes per table — hence the entry counts.

Things that easily get lost in everyday use.
app.Letzter Wert liegt länger als der gewähl: Last value is older than the chosen threshold (entities.last_ts) — usually harmless (standby, rare sensor), but an early hint of a dead integration or a renamed/removed HA entity.
app.Archivweit erkannte doppelte Zeitstempel: Duplicate timestamps detected across the archive, last 30 days.
app.Keine Duplikate in den letzten 30 Tagen: No duplicates found in the last 30 days.

app.Entitäten, deren Ausreißer-Erkennung meh: Entities whose outlier detection marks more than {outlier_notable_percent} % of their values — then the threshold is set too tight for this signal and the cleanup page shows normal behavior as suspicious. The same numbers appear below the threshold field of the respective entity.
app.Eine zu enge Schwelle korrigiert man je: A threshold that is too tight is corrected per entity: open the configuration page, choose one level higher, recalculate the rate.
app.Keine auffälligen Quoten. Höchster gemes: No notable rates. Highest measured value: {percent_label} % for {friendly_name}.

app.Alle {measured} Entitäten mit Ausreißer-: All {measured} entities with outlier detection have been measured, each over their complete history.
app.Entitäten, deren Lücken-Erkennung strukt: Entities whose gap detection can structurally never apply — the chosen resolution or the active value change filter already enforces a larger minimum distance between values.

app.Speicherindex prüfen und bereits markier: Check the storage index and permanently remove already marked records from hot buffer and archive.
app.Nicht Zeitarchivs eigener Verbrauch (Zah: Not Zeitarchiv’s own usage (figures below), but the free space on the disk itself.
app.Read-only-Übersicht der noch rückgängig: Read-only overview of the deletion marks that can still be undone.
app.Verdichtet bereits archivierte Monate au: Automatically compacts already archived months to the compaction target set per entity (configuration) as soon as they have reached the minimum age. Only affects entities whose compaction target is not “Off”.
app.Korrektur, Hinzufügen, Bereinigen, Verdi: Correction, adding, cleanup, compaction and retention, each modifying records. Backup is left out because it concerns the whole installation rather than individual records.
app.Rotiert Entitäten, die keine neuen Werte: Rotates entities that no longer send new values and would otherwise never be archived automatically.
app.Ermittelt aus den bestehenden Dashboard-: Derived from the existing dashboard tiles — as soon as a chart or table is pinned somewhere, the entry disappears here by itself.

app.Bestehende Daten aus anderen Quellen ein: Import existing data from other sources — as a Symcon db export or as a CSV file with free column/format mapping.
app.So funktioniert die einmalige Migration: How the one-time migration from Symcon works:
app.Den Symcon-<code>db</code>-Ordner als ZI: Upload the Symcon db folder as a ZIP file. Zeitarchiv unpacks and scans the contents automatically.
app.Optional die aus Symcon exportierte <cod: Optionally add the settings.json exported from Symcon. It provides plain names, parent rooms/categories and units; the db folder itself contains only numeric variable IDs.
app.Variablen markieren und Home-Assistant-E: Select variables and assign Home Assistant entities. If units differ, check the notice and enter a conversion factor if needed, then start the preview and import.
app.Bestehende Monatsarchive werden nicht ve: Existing monthly archives are not modified; in the current hot buffer, the import only adds timestamps that do not exist yet. Afterwards Zeitarchiv recalculates the rollups automatically. Unreadable files are flagged, boolean values are normalized to 1/0 and pure text variables are not imported. The uploaded source data stays stored until “Delete source data”; a new ZIP upload replaces it completely.
app.Noch keine <code>settings.json</code> im: No settings.json imported yet — optional, provides plain names and units per Symcon ID from Symcon’s object tree for the list below.
app.Bereits entpackte Daten werden eingelese: Already unpacked data is being read — this can take a while with many variables.
app.ZIP-Datei mit dem Symcon-<code>db</code>: Drag the ZIP file with the Symcon db folder here or click to choose
app.Max. {zip_upload_gib} GiB Upload, {zip_u: Max. {zip_upload_gib} GiB upload, {zip_uncompressed_gib} GiB unpacked and {zip_members} entries. Stays stored until you delete the data.
app.Keine Symcon-Variablen im hochgeladenen: No Symcon variables found in the uploaded archive.
app.So funktioniert der Import einer CSV-Dat: How importing a CSV file works:
app.Eine CSV-Datei hochladen und Trennzeiche: Upload a CSV file and set the delimiter and any existing header row.
app.Zeitstempel- und Wertspalte auswählen un: Choose the timestamp and value columns and specify the time format: Unix seconds, Unix milliseconds, ISO 8601 or a custom pattern.
app.Eine vorhandene Home-Assistant-Entität a: Choose an existing Home Assistant entity as the target, check the preview and start the import.
app.Bestehende Monatsarchive bleiben unverän: Existing monthly archives remain unchanged; in the current hot buffer, only missing timestamps are added. The uploaded CSV file stays stored until “Delete source data”.
app.So funktioniert der Import aus Home Assi: How importing from Home Assistant works:
app.Importmodus wählen: Der empfohlene Volli: Choose the import mode: the recommended full import automatically connects older long-term statistics with the more recent raw history. Both sources can also be imported individually.
app.Gewünschte Zeiträume festlegen und bei B: Set the desired periods and check availability if needed. Entities that have already transferred at least one live value to Zeitarchiv are available for selection.
app.Entitäten markieren und den Dry Run star: Select entities and start the dry run. The preview shows available values, the calculated interface and new or to-be-supplemented months.
app.Import starten. Vorhandene Zeitstempel u: Start the import. Existing timestamps and values are never replaced; the current month is supplemented in the hot buffer.
app.Beim Vollimport endet die ältere Stunden: In a full import, the older hourly statistics end at a clear interface where the raw history begins. This way, merging creates neither time gaps nor overlaps.
app.Bereits archivierte Monate werden nur er: Already archived months are only supplemented if “Fill archive gaps” is enabled.
app.Aktuelle Meldungen der App — unter Home: Current messages of the app — under Home Assistant directly from the Supervisor log.
app.Archiv-weite Kennzahlen — Aufschlüsselun: Archive-wide key figures — breakdown by type, resolution and retention, growth over time.
app.Noch nicht genug Verlaufsdaten &mdash; Z: Not enough history data yet — Zeitarchiv saves a snapshot every hour regardless of page views (entities, records, size). Once more than one snapshot exists, the growth curve appears here.
app.Erste Seite beim Öffnen, z. B. über die: First page when opening, e.g. via the HA sidebar
app.Hell/Dunkel vom System oder fest gewählt: Light/dark from the system or fixed
app.Hier sofort, andere Seiten beim Neuladen: Immediately here, other pages on reload
app.Charts auf den Kacheln animiert aufbauen: Build up the charts on the tiles with animation
app.Startwerte für das Optionen-Menü der Cha: Initial values for the options menu of the chart page. If something is changed there, it applies permanently to that one entity — until “Reset to default”.
app.Zeitraum relativ zu jetzt statt ab Kalen: Period relative to now instead of from the calendar boundary: “Day” = last 24 hours
app.Ungeglättete Einzelwerte statt Aggregati: Unsmoothed individual values instead of aggregation
app.Datenpunkte auf der Linie markieren: Mark data points on the line
app.Zahlenwerte direkt am Punkt einblenden: Show numeric values directly at the point
app.Skala passt sich dem sichtbaren Bereich: Scale adapts to the visible range
app.Min/Max/Ø direkt in der Legende zeigen: Show min/max/avg directly in the legend
app.Welche Kennzahlen die Legende zeigt: Which key figures the legend shows
